description:
Search Pinterest pins by keyword: up to 50 results with images/videos, titles, descriptions, outbound links, board and pinner.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: query (string), pins (array<object>), pins_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return. Example: 20

query.description: Search keywords (up to 200 characters). Example: "minimalist kitchen"

name: pinterest_search
title: Pinterest search
